notes: Clean single-column SaaS billing invoice (Slack -> MineralTree), OCR'd from a PNG. Single line item ('Business+ Monthly User License' / 115 / $15.00 / $1,725.00) splits across lines in OCR output so it's not caught by the line-item regex, same limitation as 100-charles. Vendor comes back lowercase ('slack') because that's how OCR read the logo wordmark -- a cosmetic artifact, not a wrong entity.
